sent: Fall / injury on the 6th floor, 363 Sam Houston Pky, Houston. Caller: "Hi, I'm at Northbelt, the office building on Sam Houston Parkway, the sixth floor. A woman fell off a step ladder in our office. She hit her head. She's awake, but she's confused and there's blood. She's in her sixties, I think. She can't get up. Can you send someone? We're by the elevators."
text:
PRIMESIGHT | FALL / INJURY | FLOOR 6, 363 Sam Houston Pky | woman 60s fell off step ladder, hit head; awake, confused, bleeding, can't get up; breathing: not stated
Northbelt - 363 N Sam Houston Pky E, Houston, TX
ELEVATOR: 1 freight car on record (fits a stretcher), 7 passenger
ON FLOOR: caller is by the elevators; 6 suites 600-660, largest Crystal CoWorks ste 660
MEET: property mgr Realty.com 555-980-6802, text queued for property manager (not sent)
NOT KNOWN: patient's suite, AED location, where the freight elevator is
Reply MORE for the rest, or ask a question.

checks.why: 363 Sam Houston Pky (the building name alone isn't enough: crews route to a street address)
from the call: she hit her head
from the call: she is confused and bleeding
freight elevator on record (fits a stretcher; in tall buildings elevator access is where minutes go)

claims.claim: The address is 363 N Sam Houston Pky E, Houston, TX.
claims.evidence: The record says 363 Sam Houston Pky, Houston, TX. It has no N or E.

claims.claim: The freight car fits a stretcher.
claims.evidence: The record has no elevator dimensions or capacity.

claims.claim: Crystal CoWorks is the largest tenant on the floor.
claims.evidence: Employees is null and no tenant has square footage, so size can't be compared.

claims.claim: The property manager's phone number is 555-980-6802.
claims.evidence: The phone number matches the record.

delivery.feedback: Cut the repeated address, the 'text queued' note and the 'Reply MORE' line to get under about 70 words.

feedback: Don't state things the building record doesn't back up. 'Fits a stretcher' and 'largest' are invented, and the N and E in the address aren't in the record. Crews act on these, so say 'size not on record' or leave them out.

'Largest Crystal CoWorks' is a poor guess at the patient's suite. The caller never named a suite, so list the suites on the floor and say the suite is unknown. Say which elevator is closest to the caller, and give the stairs as a fallback.
Make it shorter. The address is repeated, and the 'text queued' and 'Reply MORE' lines add noise. Keep the patient's condition and 'breathing not stated' at the top.
